name: Yerrr
author: djc
description: Jarvis-like NYC dashboard: 311, MTA subway, Citi Bike, NYPD, Air Quality, DOB, Parking, Lottery, Cannabis dispensaries (NY OCM) — cross-referenced by zip/borough/time. Clean overview with OSM map of your area, local-update chips, and click-through dataset detail panels. Bar icon expands to full dash with wavy sprite, voice, and terminal. Location-aware via GeoClue/nmcli.
